release.description:
## [1.5.0] - 2026-01-27

### Bug Fixes

- commitpkg: Quiet git ls-files output #281
- release: Use unique partial dirs
- license: Add .gitignore to REUSE defaults
- pkgctl build: Check if chroot version file exists before reading
- pkgctl build: Create artifact target directories if they dont exist
- util: Ensure exported vars are not crossing process boundaries
- completion: Fix bash completion for the license subcommand
- pkgctl build, pkgctl version upgrade: Handle pkgver values containing regex metacharacters
- util: Only load makepkg.conf once to avoid warnings in pacman 7.1

### Documentation

- pkgctl: Add license sub-command to pkgctl.1
- pkgctl: Add pkgctl-license entry to see also

### Features

- commitpkg: Change warning to hard error when licensing information is absent
- pkgctl version check: Disallow using the "cmd" source for nvchecker
- license: Extend matches for sysusers/tmpfiles configs
- pkgctl build: Invoke pkgctl offload server subcommand over ssh
- makechrootpkg: Support NPROC from makepkg.conf
- Allow building for unsupported architecture
- util: Make sure SRCPKGDEST is exported before shelling out
- pkgctl version check: Support combiner source for version check commands #216

### Miscellaneous Tasks

- pkgctl license check: Avoid sourcing PKGBUILD in check subcommand
- config: Sync makepkg.conf and pacman.conf with pacman v7.1

### Makechrootpkg

- Install /etc/makepkg.d/gitconfig in chroots
